# Kronos Films — the reactors in motion
> Computed films of the three Kronos machines, rendered from the frozen design geometry.

/ (/films/): film gallery — Hyperion (breeder), Aegis (burner), MetroVolt (burner). 4K hero loops + 30s/60s/4-minute narrated features.

Products:
- Hyperion — strategic-isotope spherical-tokamak breeder
- Aegis — fixed-installation D-3He burner
- MetroVolt — data-center D-3He burner (same burner core as Aegis)
